function_contracts.signature_after: def serve(config: SignatureServiceConfig, *, shutdown: ShutdownSignal) -> int
function_contracts.responsibility: Bootstrap validate and serve the protected verifier then stage shutdown with replay and audit durability preserved.
body_steps: B01 validate all canonical config paths identities and resource bounds
B02 resolve secret handles and load the fingerprint-pinned policy
B03 open the exclusive persistent replay store and attestation ledger
B04 construct SignatureVerificationRuntime and run readiness checks
B05 build bind and start the TLS server before declaring ready
B06 on shutdown stop admission drain in-flight requests flush ledger and replay state
B07 close locks and return zero only after graceful durable shutdown
error_branches: config policy secret store or ledger startup failure returns non-zero before readiness
bind TLS or readiness failure closes opened resources and returns non-zero
shutdown deadline flush or close failure returns non-zero and never claims graceful
function_contracts.security_boundary: Startup and shutdown preserve fail-closed trust replay and audit guarantees across process restarts.
function_contracts.atomicity: Readiness is published only after all dependencies and the listener are valid; shutdown orders admission before durability close.
function_contracts.idempotency: Restarting with unchanged durable state recovers the same claims and policy identity without replay reset.
function_contracts.rollback: Restore the existing hard-block behavior and retain all externally produced immutable evidence.

function_contracts.signature_after: def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int
function_contracts.responsibility: Parse explicit service runtime arguments and invoke serve without accepting ambient trust or secret configuration.
inputs: explicit policy secret replay ledger TLS and listen arguments
body_steps: B01 parse only documented required CLI arguments and reject unknown flags
B02 canonicalize config paths and immutable policy identity
B03 build SignatureServiceConfig without reading secret values
B04 install bounded termination signals and shutdown deadline
B05 invoke serve exactly once and propagate its exit code
B06 redact exception output and never retry with weaker defaults
error_branches: missing unknown duplicate or unsafe argument returns usage error
ambient environment fallback is rejected
serve exception or non-graceful shutdown returns non-zero
function_contracts.security_boundary: Trust policy secrets TLS replay and ledger locations must be explicit and cannot come from attacker-controlled ambient state.
function_contracts.atomicity: One validated CLI configuration starts at most one server runtime.
function_contracts.idempotency: The same explicit configuration and durable state have the same startup decision.
function_contracts.rollback: Restore the existing hard-block behavior and retain all externally produced immutable evidence.

type_contracts.responsibility: Own the complete immutable process dependency graph required for trustworthy HTTP verification readiness recovery and shutdown.
invariants: policy is valid and fingerprint pinned at construction
replay store is persistent exclusive and schema compatible
attestation ledger is append-only durable and schema compatible
secret resolver exposes opaque handles only
clock and resource limits are explicitly injected
runtime identity binds public dependency identities
construction_rules: construct only after all dependency startup probes pass
reject duplicate or mismatched runtime dependency identities
do not permit post-construction dependency replacement
close dependencies only through staged serve shutdown
type_contracts.security_boundary: The aggregate is the sole explicit bridge between process adapters and trust-domain functions and cannot carry secret bytes.
type_contracts.rollback: Destroy the unactivated runtime and preserve the current hard block and durable stores.

type_contracts.responsibility: Define the compile-time candidate repository trust context and verifier client abstractions used by migrated registry validation callers.
invariants: repository root is absolute canonical and immutable
candidate commit is a full immutable object ID
profile environment purpose and policy identity are mandatory
verifier protocol returns a typed attestation only
no ambient repository or endpoint selection is represented
construction_rules: construct trust context from validated candidate and execution identity
inject verifier implementation at the caller boundary
reject empty wildcard or default identity fields
type_contracts.security_boundary: These types prevent ambient repository and verifier selection from bypassing explicit candidate and trust identity.
type_contracts.rollback: Retain existing signatures and unconditional hard block until all migrated callers compile and review.

type_contracts.responsibility: Define every compile-time domain protocol configuration and adapter boundary required by the protected verifier service.
fields: request and attestation exact identity fields
loaded policy anchor algorithm role and revocation fields
replay claim identity disposition and expiry
secret replay ledger clock and shutdown protocols
HTTP TLS server limits config and response types
invariants: all concrete dataclasses are frozen slotted and schema aligned
all protocols expose the minimum method surface
PASS attestation contains every request binding
secret handles cannot expose raw bytes
persistent store and ledger protocols require durable operations
HTTP and TLS types encode closed routes and resource bounds
construction_rules: declare concrete data before functions that consume it
use Protocol for injected I O clock and shutdown capabilities
avoid Any dictionary or ambient global substitutes at trust boundaries
version all durable and wire-visible declarations
type_contracts.security_boundary: The type set closes compile-time ambiguity across cryptography replay audit HTTP TLS configuration and shutdown seams.
type_contracts.rollback: Remove the unimplemented type candidate and preserve schemas hard block and all active registries.

oracles: all signed identity fields are required
PASS is impossible without exact request binding
private keys tokens and raw secrets are forbidden
security_constraints: additionalProperties is false on trust-bearing objects
algorithms roles scopes and status use closed enums
non_function_contracts.rollback: Retain the prior schemas and hard block; do not migrate any producer or consumer.

input_contract: digest-pinned base image and requirements lock
output_contract: externally buildable SBOM and provenance inputs
oracles: base image uses an immutable digest
runtime user is non-root and filesystem is read-only compatible
dependency lock contains exact hashes and no floating versions
security_constraints: no trust anchor credential or private key is copied into the image
build network and package inputs are explicit and auditable
non_function_contracts.rollback: Remove the unbuilt package candidate and retain the existing verifier hard block.

input_contract: G0 static unit schema and eleven-case observations
oracles: one positive and ten negative cases are enumerated
every actual result is machine-derived and candidate-bound
status remains NOT_RUN until an authorized runner writes evidence
security_constraints: self-reported fixture PASS cannot satisfy an oracle
evidence contains hashes and redacted diagnostics only
non_function_contracts.rollback: Preserve immutable attempted evidence and leave G0 unsatisfied after candidate rollback.

input_contract: G1 restart rotation expiry revocation and rollback observations
oracles: restart retains no unverified PASS
policy rotation and revocation become effective within bounds
rollback restores hard-block behavior without receipt loss
security_constraints: test secrets are referenced through approved secret storage
failure diagnostics never contain private keys or tokens
non_function_contracts.rollback: Preserve immutable G1 observations and restore the previously approved isolated revision.

input_contract: approved namespace secret and policy references
output_contract: NetworkPolicy health probes resources and rollback annotations
oracles: image reference is digest-only and supplied by the external receipt
replicas or activation gate defaults to off
network and secret access are least privilege
security_constraints: manifest contains references but no secret values
pod is non-root read-only and drops capabilities
non_function_contracts.rollback: Scale the candidate to zero and restore the last approved digest while preserving all evidence.

input_contract: G6 health stop-threshold and rollback observations
oracles: canary identity equals the external image receipt
stop thresholds are evaluated before wider traffic
hard-block rollback is demonstrated and timed
security_constraints: operator and environment identity are receipt-bound
non_function_contracts.rollback: Preserve the failed canary record and scale the verifier candidate to zero.

input_contract: G2 functional fault and authorization observations
oracles: positive request succeeds only with exact authority
all ten negative families fail closed
timeout malformed and unavailable dependencies never return PASS
security_constraints: test certificates are non-production and bounded
request and response logs are redacted and hash-bound
non_function_contracts.rollback: Preserve G2 results and disable endpoint routing before restoring the hard block.

input_contract: request attestation replay and caller result ledgers
G3 reconciliation window and candidate identity
oracles: request attestation replay and caller counts reconcile
every PASS maps to one exact replay claim
unexplained difference is exactly zero
security_constraints: reconciliation uses hashes rather than payload or secret values
late duplicate and conflicting replay are reported separately
non_function_contracts.rollback: Preserve reconciliation evidence and keep the candidate disabled on any non-zero unexplained difference.

cross_cutting_invariants: The v2 completion exact-set contains the 36 designed non-terminal members and preserves P066 as a non-executable terminal.
Every function contract owns exactly the catalog primary function locator and all catalog companion locators.
Every non-function contract owns exactly its declarative package manifest or evidence locator set.
Repository selection is explicit from validate_implementation_candidate through every Git blob hash and tree helper.
Candidate-controlled paths are canonical repository-relative paths and symlink or traversal escapes fail before byte reads.
A trusted PASS binds payload candidate commit profile environment purpose policy nonce validity and verifier identity.
Certificate chain algorithm EKU validity revocation authority role and conditional CNAS scope all fail closed.
Replay state is linearizable and distinguishes exact idempotent retry from conflicting nonce substitution.
Runtime readiness requires policy secret replay ledger and server health while shutdown stops admission before durable flush and close.
Secret values private keys credentials and bearer tokens are absent from schemas images manifests logs attestations and evidence.
The deployment image build sign and publish activity remains external and cannot be inferred from a Dockerfile or manifest.
G0 G1 G2 G3 and G6 each own one immutable evidence output pair and no pair asserts more than one gate.
Review artifacts evidence files implementation image signatures deployment and authorization remain absent until independently produced.
The four active registry artifacts remain byte-for-byte unchanged and formal execution stays blocked.
Rollback restores the current cryptographic hard block before traffic removal and never deletes immutable attempt evidence.

rollback.entrypoint: Any trust validation deployment or evidence mismatch
steps: stop candidate verifier routing before changing caller behavior
scale the candidate verifier deployment to zero
restore the existing require_trusted_signature_verifier hard block
restore the last approved policy and image digest where applicable
retain request attestation replay claim and evidence artifacts
record the triggering invariant and candidate identity
re-run static validation before proposing another candidate
rollback.durable_evidence_policy: Attempted evidence and externally signed artifacts are immutable and never deleted or rewritten by rollback.
rollback.irreversible_boundary: No irreversible boundary is authorized by this design; global switch deployment and acceptance require later signed decisions.

claims.allowed: P057-P062 and P067-P096 function type and specialized non-function behavior is statically specified against v2 preview
